## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For provider work, distinguish synthetic
fixture coverage from any live verification. Do not include private account data.

## Review notes

Mention API changes, provider/platform limitations, and any remaining work.

- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or failures and skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] Provider coverage, README tables/counts, and examples are updated if affected.
- [ ] No credentials, private account payloads, or build output are included.
